name: Washington Workplace
old_description: Providing Commercial Furnishings in DC, Virginia, Maryland & Beyond
about:
Washington Workplace operates from Arlington, Virginia, serving the Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia corridor as well as clients nationwide. The company functions as an office furniture dealership, supplying contract furnishings and delivering a suite of workplace design services.

Its core offering combines product sales with end-to-end project execution. Services include space planning and design, budgeting, project management, furniture installation, office maintenance, and storage solutions. The firm handles projects ranging from complete workplace redesigns to targeted furniture refreshes, coordinating logistics and installation through its own teams.

The client base spans commercial offices, government agencies, and organizations throughout the DMV region seeking to improve workplace functionality and employee well‑being. Engagements typically begin with a free consultation to assess spatial needs, followed by furniture specification, procurement, and installation management.

Washington Workplace frames its differentiation around a partnership model that prioritizes occupant well‑being over transactional sales. The company’s stated philosophy — “People | Products | Ideas…that make a difference” — reflects a focus on guiding clients through the entire design‑to‑installation process rather than simply supplying catalog items.
